messages:
Marta (People Ops): Quick one  I'm assembling a lightweight 'seatbelt' packet for new managers: micro day plan + 2-week rules + crisp 30/60/90 prompts. Want it short enough to slip into an offer email. Can you glance and add missing musts?

Evan (Hiring Manager): Love the idea. Please include a tiny stakeholder list they should send by day 5 (infra, security, product, recruiting).

Rhea (Eng Manager): Add: oncall shadow scheduled within 10 days for teams with rotations, and a note to request Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota early if they're leading model work.

Marta (People Ops): Draft below. Intention: copy-paste friendly, checkboxes for ops to mark off.

Marta (People Ops): SEATBELT: first-day micro-plan
- 09:00 meet People Ops (paperwork + benefits quick pass)
- 09:30 confirm Google / Slack / GitHub accounts + MFA
- 10:00 team hello (10m) + set buddy shadow for day 2
- 11:00 IT access check (Redwood Console viewer, VPN)
- 14:00 security intro (SSO/KMS owner)
- EOD: block daily focus hour tomorrow and add 30/60/90 template to calendar

Marta (People Ops): CHECKLIST (make sure these are completed in HR system)
- [ ] Google workspace active
- [ ] Slack + team channel access
- [ ] GitHub org perms
- [ ] Redwood Console viewer access submitted
- [ ] Payroll + benefits enrollment done

Marta (People Ops): FIRST WEEK MUSTS (manager)
- Meet each direct report for 30m (use 30/60/90 prompts)
- By Day 5: share 1-slide stakeholder map (who to contact for infra, security, product, recruiting)
- Verify CI/CD and deploy-bot access
- If team owns oncall: schedule oncall shadow within 10 days
- Complete 7-day pulse (3 Qs: accounts missing? role clear? blockers?)

Marta (People Ops): TWO-WEEK GUIDELINES
- Keep interviews <= 2/day for first 14 days
- Avoid >4 hours meetings/day; prefer 2 x 30m office hours and 1h focus block
- Staging RBAC by default; prod access via request + security approval

Marta (People Ops): 30/60/90 PROMPTS (short)
- 30d: map org & stakeholders, meet skip-levels, unblock 2 priority tickets, complete first interview loop
- 60d: run a postmortem or lead planning, propose 1 process improvement, close a hire (if applicable)
- 90d: present Q+1 plan + 2 measurable KPIs, update onboarding docs for ICs

Evan (Hiring Manager): Hiring addendum: candidate scorecards completed within 48h and panel debrief within 72h. Put that in the 'hiring expectations' line.

Rhea (Eng Manager): Ops addendum: include a short link to model catalog + deploy policy, and a step to request Dedicated/GPU quota if relevant. Also recommend a default 'no back-to-back all-day meetings' rule first 2 weeks.

Jon (Security): Note: prod access will require an access justification and security review. Introduce SSO/KMS owner by Day 2. We'll enforce the approval flow.

Marta (People Ops): WHO TO ASK (day 1 shortcuts)
- People Ops: Marta / Priya (payroll & benefits)
- Infra: Rhea / devinfra-team
- Security: Jon (SSO/KMS)
- Recruiting: Evan
- DevRel/SDK: Robin

Marta (People Ops): SAMPLE SLACK ANNOUNCE (pasteable)
"Hi team, please welcome <Name> joining as <Role> on <Date>. I'll run a 10-15m intro at 10:00 to say hi and share top priorities. Drop a welcome note in #team."

WelcomeBot: Checklist template copied to /docs/onboarding/manager-seatbelt.md

Marta (People Ops): Plan: I'll convert this into a one-pager PDF and attach to the offer email tonight. If no further edits, we can close this thread. :white_check_mark:
